(Through virtual mode)
 Case: - Crm(M) No. 841/2025
 CrlM No. 2132/2025
 Ghulam Mohammad Bhat ...Petitioner(s)/A
 Through: Mr. Syed Sajad Geelani, Advocate.
 V/s
 Madiha and others ....

Respond
 Through:
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Dhar, Judge

The petitioner has challenged complaint filed by respondent no.1 against him and co-accused before the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate 1st Class (Munsiff) Srinagar alleging commission of offences punishable under Sections 406/409/420 and 34 IPC.

It has been contended by the learned counsel for the petitioner that dispute between the parties is purely civil in nature but the complainant has given it a criminal colour by filing the impugned complaint.
Issue notice to the respondent no.1 only subject to the petitioner's taking necessary steps within a week's time.
In the meantime, proceedings in the impugned complaint as against the petitioner shall remain stayed before the Trial Court.
